occupations.title: Business Intelligence Analysts
occupations.rationale: Looker is explicitly described as an "Analytics & BI software product" and an "agentic BI platform" [D:Looker:landing:1] that enables "Self-Service BI" for users including "human analysts" [D:Looker:landing:3].

occupations.title: Data Scientists
occupations.rationale: The product is a "dynamic data analytics powerhouse" that integrates with data warehouses like BigQuery to "transform raw information into actionable insights" using a "semantic modeling layer" [D:Looker:landing:8, D:Looker:landing:9], which are core tasks for data scientists.

occupations.title: Financial Managers
occupations.rationale: The excerpts highlight a specific use case for "cloud cost management" that gives "finance and engineering teams real-time visibility into multicloud spend" to optimize budgets [D:Looker:landing:11].
